Save Sideview Widget to a Standalone HTML File

Source: R/widget.R
save_sideview.Rd

Exports a sideview htmlwidget or table objects to a self-contained HTML file with all styles, fonts, and JavaScript embedded.

Usage

save_sideview(
  widget,
  file,
  selfcontained = TRUE,
  title = "Sideview",
  background = "white",
  ...
)

Arguments

widget

A sideview htmlwidget object, or tabular data objects that can be converted to one via sideview_widget.

file

Path to the output HTML file (e.g. "report.html").

selfcontained

Logical; whether to produce a standalone HTML file with all CSS and JavaScript dependencies inlined. Defaults to TRUE.

title

HTML title for the output page. Default "Sideview".

background

Background color for the document body. Default "white".

...

Additional arguments passed to htmlwidgets::saveWidget().

Value

The normalized path to the saved file (invisibly).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
save_sideview(mtcars, file = "cars_sideview.html")
} # }
